next_seed.error: preflight bind on 127.0.0.1:8350 returned EADDRINUSE 0.224 s after previous run finished

incident.evidence: The successful run final monitor sample recorded an empty server process group and GPU memory returned to baseline; server.log says Strata stopped. Current live process scan and listener check are empty. Strata Linux HTTP server sets SO_REUSEADDR; Q35 preflight bind did not. Probable cause: harmless TCP TIME_WAIT mistaken for an active listener. No model request occurred on seed 2.

change.scope: Q35 test harness only; no product profile, weights, model settings, GUI, or inference server outside this run.
change.implementation: Set SO_REUSEADDR on the preflight probe socket before bind. Linux TIME_WAIT is allowed; a real listener must still block. Leave inference-server process scan in place.
regressions: A live listener on the task port is rejected.
A TCP port in TIME_WAIT after a clean close can pass the bindability probe when reuse is enabled.
The probe closes its socket and leaves no listener.
change.verification: CPU-only regression suite and py_compile; no GPU used for this fix.
